summary: PJM posts the agenda for a Special Members Committee meeting on November 5, 2026. Its single item is consultation on a suite of section 205 filings responding to the Large Load Show Cause Order.

points.point: The Special MC meets November 5, 2026 from 2:15 to 5:00 p.m. EPT in Audubon, PA.
points.quote: Special Members Committee Two Hundred Ninety-first Meeting PJM Conference and Training Center, Audubon, PA November 5, 2026

points.point: PJM gives notice of consultation with the Members Committee and Transmission Owners on tariff changes tied to the show cause order.
points.quote: PJM Notice of Consultation with the Members Committee pursuant to Tariff Section 9.2(b) and Transmission Owners pursuant to CTOA Section 7.5.1(ii)

points.point: PJM staff will consult on a suite of section 205 filings addressing the Large Load Show Cause Order and related reforms.
points.quote: PJM staff will consult with stakeholders on plans to submit a suite of section 205 filings to address Tariff revisions to address opportunities identified in the Large Load Show Cause Order and related reforms.

throughLine.text: Shows PJM taking the section 205 route offered by the E-7 show cause order: a suite of tariff filings, with consultation set for November 5, 2026, ahead of the abeyance deadline of November 16.
